title: What geofencing means
body_md: Geofencing places a virtual fence around the vehicle. If the vehicle then leaves the area around its original location stated by the source, a theft report is received.
prev_context: Before this stands the note on authorised numbers.
next_context: The switch positions in which geofencing can be switched follow.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 21: equivalent in substance. Both versions name the same radius; it is not reproduced under BLK-007 and because three values are on record across the generations (DSC-078).
